far.label: At a distance
far.figureTitle: Far off a unit keeps its own model, grown to the smallest figure size.
far.arrowTitle: Far off a unit becomes a simple shape of its kind: an aircraft arrow, a helicopter, a hull, a vehicle, a dot for a soldier.
far.symbolTitle: Far off a unit becomes a map symbol, crossfaded from its model.
far.symbolHint: A unit becomes its symbol where its model would be grown to the smallest figure size.
far.othersTitle: What the teams that are not mine are.
far.weaponMarks: Drop lines and labels on weapons
far.weaponMarksTitle: Weapons in flight get drop lines and name labels like the units.
far.decoysTitle: Flares, chaff, shells and debris in the lists.
far.firesTitle: Flames and smoke where a unit's part burns, from when it catches fire until it is out, wrecks included.
far.hitMarksTitle: The mark each shot left on a unit, on its surface where it struck, sized by the calibre and shaped by what it did, riding with the unit; point at one for who fired it.
far.hitMarkFloatTitle: A marker over each fresh hit as well, facing you, for 10 s.
far.hitLookSplash: Bright splash: did not get through
far.hitLookScorch: Soot star: explosive round (HE, HEAT, HESH)
far.aimLinesTitle: From each vehicle: where its player looks (dashed) and where its turret's gun points (solid), where the data says.
far.aimLinesLegend: Dashed: where the player looks. Solid: the gun; faint where the data has no turret and it follows the aim.
